messages:
Celia: Quick PSA: Tomorrow is our 1-year work anniversary at Redwood! I can't believe it's been a year. Thinking of doing a tiny celebratory potluck in the kitchen at 4pm. Bring snacks, stories, or a single embarrassing onboarding anecdote.
Marco: Congrats team!! I'll bring my famous spicy empanadas (vegetarian option included).
Tess: I'll bring iced tea and a playlist of embarrassing 2010s songs.
Arun: Count me in. Also happy anniversary Celia!! 
FacilitiesBot: FYI: Kitchen use reserved 4pm-5pm. Please clear the island by 5:15pm for cleaning staff.
Celia: Thanks FacilitiesBot 44d Will put up a sign. Also is anyone able to bring extra plates/napkins?
Marco: I have disposable plates and forks, 20 count.
Tess: I can bring napkins and a small vase for a plant table centerpiece.
Arun: Can we do a 2-minute "what I learned in my first year" round? Low-pressure, optional.
Celia: Love that idea. Quick opt-in: react with :raised_hands: if you want to share a quick reflection.
Tess: :raised_hands: I'll go first and tell the story about the printer that ate my badge.
Marco: :raised_hands: I will bring a short tale about a deploy that somehow magically fixed itself.
FacilitiesBot: Reminder: No open flames in kitchen. Candles are not permitted.
CateringBot: Cake request accepted. If someone drops off "Anniversary / Celia" I will refrigerate until 3:45pm.
Arun: I'll sneak a tiny paper crown for Celia. Totally optional.
Celia: Haha no crown necessary but definitely appreciated. See you all at 4, and thanks for making the year memorable. 
Marco: Congrats to the whole crew!
Tess: Can't wait. Also someone bring a camera or I will use my phone and post in #random.
Celia: Please post! And thanks again everyone 60a
